'''1997 Sullust Regionals (Prague)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Sullust region (Italy, Greece, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Croatia, Slovenia, Turkey, Hungary).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Sullust)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 5 October 1997
* '''Site:''' NET WAVE, Prague, Czech Republic
